svg.title: Java Learning Roadmap
svg.desc: A vertical roadmap showing the path from completing the beginner Java course to becoming a job-ready junior developer, with five phases: immediate setup, core Java gaps, build things, the big framework, and job ready.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What was covered in the beginner Java course?')
sendPrompt('How do I get started with Git and GitHub?')
sendPrompt('How do I set up IntelliJ IDEA for Java?')
sendPrompt('Teach me Java lambdas and Streams with examples')
sendPrompt('How do Java threads and ExecutorService work?')
sendPrompt('What is Optional in Java and when should I use it?')
sendPrompt('Explain Java design patterns for beginners')
sendPrompt('How do I use Maven or Gradle to manage a Java project?')
sendPrompt('Teach me unit testing with JUnit 5 in Java')
sendPrompt('How do I connect Java to a SQL database using JDBC?')
sendPrompt('Teach me Spring Boot from scratch')
g.text: REST APIs · dependency injection · JPA · security

sendPrompt('What are common Java interview questions for junior developers?')
sendPrompt('How do I write a good junior developer resume for Java jobs?')
